dedupe_keys.name: borehole lithological facies dataset for interval kriging

description: Yuqi Song and Frank Tsai publish borehole and grid data for four interval-kriging case studies of three-dimensional lithological structure. The Zenodo package accompanies a 2024 Water Resources Research paper on estimating sand and non-sand facies from irregular borehole intervals. The ZIP is free under CC BY-NC 4.0, so commercial reuse needs separate permission. Numerical and real-world examples can benchmark subsurface reconstruction before groundwater or buried-infrastructure simulations. The method accounts for horizontal and vertical anisotropy and regularises estimation variance, as described by the primary paper. Exact geographical extents, borehole counts, observation dates and internal file formats remain unknown from the repository summary. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this benchmark collection. Reconstructed facies are estimates, not complete observed geology. Data completeness, uncertainty fields and comparisons with alternative kriging methods were not independently reproduced.
